critical_code_review_comments: _group_questions_for_comparison is a stable in-dimension re-order using a consumed-set walk; preserves non-axis question positions — matches spec. Brand-first + comp_order sort correct.
comparison_group assignment `q.get('axis_label') or tmpl['id']` is robust — non-axis templates fall back to template id so singleton siblings won't accidentally merge.

Frontend drops singleton axis groups (len<2) back into nonAxis — prevents misleading 'TOPIC · X · 1 brands' header when only us-version exists (e.g., Responsible, Relatable, Aspirational, Distinctive, Diverse-offerings all have no COMP template).

options_th is placed on all trait_grid questions: brand_list options use identity translation (brand names unchanged), trait_list uses DEFAULT_TRAIT_POOL_TH[:24], personality_traits uses PERSONALITY_TRAIT_POOL_TH. TRAIT_TH_MAP provides one-source-of-truth lookup for identity.traits.

Backend stat engine uses q.options[idx] (English) for storage — frontend QuestionInput uses opts[idx] in onChange handler, only swapping display label via optsLocalized — correct separation of storage vs presentation.
Custom quality attrs still cap at 5 (line 493 `[:5]`) by design to avoid questionnaire bloat; each attr spawns 1 us + N competitor questions matching comparison pattern.

File size: /app/backend/routes/brand_equity.py is now 1562 lines — a good candidate for splitting into brand_equity_templates.py + brand_equity_stats.py + brand_equity_routes.py. Not blocking but recommended for future maintenance.
